sin.name: agent-row-ended-outside-the-dispatcher
sin.description: Code outside the dispatcher writes the ended_at or pid field of an agent's row, so the row can say ended while its program runs, or open while no program runs, and nothing compares the two.
sin.rule: End, open or bind an agent's row through AgentDispatcher: end_row, end_session, open_row, record_process or move_program. The files this rule still allows record a launch themselves, or end the row of a replaced main session inside a hook, where the dispatcher cannot be imported.
